text: The CE undergraduate program prepares students to face career challenges by providing a sound education in Civil Engineering Materials, Concrete Structure, Masonry Structure, Steel Construction, emphasizing hands-on design projects and case studies that supply context and motivation. Students are taught how to combine theory, measurement and modeling to develop a good understanding of the problems at hand and point the way to desirable solutions. The major courses include: Building Architecture, Basic Theory of Concrete Structure, Basic Principle of Steel Structure, etc.
